cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.24)
project(lsf_c_feature_probe C)
include(CheckFunctionExists)
check_function_exists(getaddrinfo LSF_TEST_GETADDRINFO)
check_function_exists(freeaddrinfo LSF_TEST_FREEADDRINFO)
if(LSF_EXPECT_FEATURE)
  if(NOT LSF_TEST_GETADDRINFO OR NOT LSF_TEST_FREEADDRINFO)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "captured numeric resolver was not detected")
  endif()
else()
  if(LSF_TEST_GETADDRINFO OR LSF_TEST_FREEADDRINFO)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "old capture unexpectedly acquired a resolver")
  endif()
endif()
file(WRITE "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/feature-result.txt" "passed\n")
